sbt.config.title: SkyBlock Translator
sbt.config.enabled.desc: Master switch for the whole mod.
sbt.config.language.desc: Target language. Bundled dictionaries exist for Russian; other languages rely on online translation.
sbt.config.onlyOnHypixel.desc: Translate only while connected to Hypixel. Disable to test in singleplayer.
sbt.config.translateItems.desc: Item names and lore in container screens.
sbt.config.translateDialogs.desc: Server messages in chat: dialogues, quests, announcements.
sbt.config.translatePlayerChat.desc: Translate messages written by other players.
sbt.config.translateOnline.desc: Translate unknown strings through an online service and cache the result locally. With this off, only dictionaries and the cache are used.
sbt.config.onlineProvider.desc: google — free, works out of the box. libretranslate — your own instance (URL below).
sbt.config.dailyOnlineBudget.desc: Maximum online translation requests per day. Cached translations don't count.
sbt.config.libreApiKey.desc: Leave empty if the instance doesn't require one.
sbt.config.editor.entry.desc:
Original: %s

Edit the translation and save. Your edit becomes an override — it beats the dictionary and the online cache.
sbt.config.editor.empty.desc: Open some menus or tooltips in game, then come back — the latest strings will show up here for editing.
